wts_puddlejumpers.accept_text: The strand is just south-east of my door - you can smell it from here. The little ones. Bring back my dignity if you find it.

wts_gillrot.accept_text: Back on the strand, south-east of my door. He sits on the biggest rock, at its far end. His oracles heal him - thin them first, then Gillrot.

brl_ilvessa_cargo.accept_text: Out the east gate and north, to the coast of the eastern glades - that's where the ragged scavengers den with what they take off the road. They steal anything that glints.

brl_grael_pumpkins.accept_text: Out the west gate, at the Solliden Farmstead in the western glades. The threshers in the fields carry them. Uncracked. I'll know.

brl_nettles_crows.accept_text: Out in the glades west of town, the big grey ones - mangy duskbats, the Deathguard calls them. They've had my crop and my patience.

wt_manor_dead.accept_text: Clear the gardens - the zombies and the rotting dead both.

wto_korgal.accept_text: He's at the heart of the camp, under the standard. His Scarlet converts will rally to him, so thin them first.

wtf_farmhands.accept_text: Solliden Farmstead, west of Brill. The farmhands are out in the fields. Put them down gently. They were good men.

wth_maggot.accept_text: The centre of the camp at Garren's Haunt. He'll have his Rot Hide gnolls close by, so clear them first.

etl_dusk.accept_text: The duskbats, in the mooring ropes above the platform. They drop when the lines go taut.

eth_converts.accept_text: The Scarlet converts, by the fire at the outpost. Do it now, while it's the easier job.

eth_brennic.accept_text: He commands from the centre. His Scarlet converts will rally to him first.
